regulations.scope: Lasers, laser light barriers or similar with wavelength range 180nm to 1mm

tests.title: Mechanical Protective Device – Load Support Test
tests.description: Chain, cable, band, spring, belt, jack screw nut, pneumatic or hydraulic hose, structural part or the like, employed to support a load, defeated by a convenient means causing maximum normal load to fall from most adverse position permitted by construction of ME EQUIPMENT

tests.title: Safe Working Load with Patient/Operator
tests.description: Load included SAFE WORKING LOAD in 9.8.3.1 when system was capable of supporting a PATIENT or OPERATOR

tests.title: Mechanical Protective Device – No Damage
tests.description: No evidence of damage to MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICE affecting its ability to perform its intended function

tests.title: Systems without Mechanical Protective Devices – Tensile Safety Factors
tests.description: Support system parts have TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS to values in Table 21, rows 1 and 2, and are not impaired by wear; or where impaired by wear, TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS to Table 21 rows 3 and 4

tests.title: Protection Against Unwanted and Excessive Radiation Hazards
X-Radiation – Air Kerma Limit
tests.description: Air kerma did not exceed 5 µGy/h at 5 cm from surface of ME EQUIPMENT including background radiation for ME EQUIPMENT not producing therapeutic/diagnostic X-radiation but producing ionizing radiation

tests.title: Risk from Unintended X-Radiation
tests.description: RISK from unintended X-radiation from ME EQUIPMENT producing X-radiation for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes addressed via applicable particular and collateral standards or RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS

tests.title: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Neutron and Other Particle Radiation
tests.description: RISK associated with alpha, beta, gamma, neutron, and other particle radiation addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS as shown in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.title: Unintended Microwave Radiation
tests.description: Power density of unintended microwave radiation at frequencies between 1 GHz and 100 GHz does not exceed 10 W/m² at any point 50 mm away from surface of ME EQUIPMENT under reference test conditions

tests.title: Laser Radiation – IEC 60825-1
tests.description: Relevant requirements of IEC 60825-1:2007 applied to lasers, laser light barriers or similar with a wavelength range of 180nm to 1mm

tests.title: Visible Electromagnetic Radiation (non-laser/LED)
tests.description: RISK associated with visible electromagnetic radiation other than emitted by lasers and LEDs addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS as indicated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.title: Infrared Radiation (non-laser/LED)
tests.description: RISK associated with infrared radiation other than emitted by lasers and LEDs addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS as indicated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.title: Ultraviolet Radiation (non-laser/LED)
tests.description: RISK associated with ultraviolet radiation other than emitted by lasers and LEDs addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS as indicated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.title: Protection Against Excessive Temperatures and Other Hazards
Temperature Limits on ME Equipment Parts – Normal Use
tests.description: Temperatures on ME EQUIPMENT parts did not exceed values in Tables 22 and 23 operating in worst-case NORMAL USE at maximum rated ambient operating temperature; surfaces of test corner did not exceed 90°C; THERMAL CUT-OUTS did not operate in NORMAL CONDITION

sub_results.check: Part surface temperatures vs Tables 22 and 23
Surfaces of test corner did not exceed 90°C
THERMAL CUT-OUTS did not operate in NORMAL CONDITION

semantic_fragments.content: Annual exposure reduced taking into account the irradiated body part, national regulations, and/or international recommendations for ME EQUIPMENT that has permanent proximity to a PATIENT as part of the INTENDED USE. Amount of radiation measured by means of an ionizing chamber radiation monitor with an effective area of 10 cm² or by other instruments producing equal results. ME EQUIPMENT operated as in NORMAL USE at most unfavourable RATED MAINS VOLTAGE and controls adjusted to emit maximum radiation. Internal pre-set controls not intended for adjustment during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of ME EQUIPMENT not taken into consideration.

Systems without MECHANICAL PROTECTIVE DEVICES: Support system parts have TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS to values in Table 21, rows 1 and 2, and are not impaired by wear. Where support system parts are impaired by wear, they have TENSILE SAFETY FACTORS to values in Table 21, rows 3 and 4. Compliance confirmed by examination of ME EQUIPMENT, design documentation and RISK MANAGEMENT FILE.
